programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play in 'Kiss Conspiracy', then in 'House Guests', Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone in 'Pizza Dash', then in 'Glory Days', the Chipmunks worry that they're making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star. (S3, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.desc: Blood and Dust: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, mourn cheetah Kuleta's loss after lions kill one of her cubs and watch as wild dog Phoenix faces down a hyena mob. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Chasing The Rains
programme.desc: Praying For Rain: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two elephant calves, then watch as Kuleta reclaims territory, before joining Phoenix on her search for a new mate. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades
programme.desc: It was once a former wasteland where an entire city's wastewater used to be deposited. Now, it's a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

programme.title: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand
programme.desc: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand: Explore a land of extremes. From Qatar's wild deserts to rare wildlife, see how human innovation reshapes a fragile landscape under climate threat. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: Arrival: Sir David Attenborough goes in search of the very first animals to inhabit our planet - a journey that begins in a forest near his childhood home in Leicester. (1 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: Conquest: Sir David Attenborough explores the beautiful landscapes of Canada's Rocky Mountains, where fossils document an explosion in animal diversity. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: Wetlands: As water flows from Australia's highlands into the seas, environmental changes set the stage for unexpected clashes between predators and their prey. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Eternal Rivals: Felines and canids clash across the world. Dive into direct battles and strategies to steal food. Intelligence and strength decide who reigns in each territory. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Big Cats Small World
programme.desc: Summer Cubs: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Big Cats Small World
programme.desc: Surviving the Flood: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Eternal Rivals: Felines and canids clash across the world. Dive into direct battles and strategies to steal food. Intelligence and strength decide who reigns in each territory. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Wild Castles

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild

programme.title: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand
programme.desc: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand: Explore a land of extremes. From Qatar's wild deserts to rare wildlife, see how human innovation reshapes a fragile landscape under climate threat. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Disorganised: Explore how being disorganised works in our fauna's favour. A chaotic approach to life can help a species get ahead in a land of extremes. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Obsessive: In the wild, being obsessive isn't a flaw, it's a means of survival. The animals of this brutal continent know that obsession equals success. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon
programme.desc: The Queen of Yala: Join young female leopard Asha as she fights for territory, finds a mate and becomes a mother in the shadowy forests of Yala National Park. (S5, ep 1)

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon
programme.desc: Loka the Baby Elephant: Journey to Minneriya National Park, where baby elephant Loka has just been born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk. (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans...
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans...
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas

programme.title: Kui Buri: Thailand's Hidden Eden
